description: Open a new incident on a status page with its first message, to tell the page's visitors about an outage. It is public and emails the page's confirmed subscribers: confirm the wording with the user before calling. Any status but RESOLVED emails every confirmed subscriber at once; RESOLVED records an already closed incident (a postmortem) and emails nobody. To add to an existing incident use post_status_page_update. Requires a key with the write scope. Returns the incident. Example: {"page_id": "<id from list_status_pages>", "title": "API errors", "body": "We are investigating elevated error rates."}

body.description: The first message. The message subscribers read, 1 to 5000 characters.

component_ids.description: The affected components: uuids from get_status_page. An id that is not a component of this page is a 404.

page_id.description: The status page's uuid from list_status_pages. An id that is not a status page of this organization is a 404.

status.description: INVESTIGATING, IDENTIFIED, MONITORING or RESOLVED; RESOLVED closes the incident on the page. Default INVESTIGATING.
